reason: The plugin synchronizes Wallpaper Engine wallpapers as the DeepSeek Harness web interface background and provides controls for monitor selection, visual effects, rendering mode, and focus mode.

summaries.zh: 将 Wallpaper Engine 当前壁纸同步为 DeepSeek Harness 网页背景，并提供显示器选择、透明度、模糊、阴影和渲染模式等控制。
summaries.en: Syncs the current Wallpaper Engine wallpaper to the DeepSeek Harness web interface background with controls for monitor selection, visual effects, rendering mode, and focus mode.

capabilities: Reads local Wallpaper Engine state and wallpaper assets
Serves a localhost diagnostic HTTP route
Renders wallpaper previews or frames in the web interface
Can use a configured external scene-renderer executable
